llm_response.reason: The website offers an unusually wide variety of valuable and collectible products (including electronics, rare liquors, fan goods) at sharply discounted prices with urgency language (up to 55% off, '即決', 1-yen listings, and offers of free/discount shipping), which matches classic online shop scam patterns (Scam points 1, 5, 13). The contact email does not match the site or company name (Scam point 6), the privacy policy and company info sections are referenced in the text but not clearly linked or accessible (Scam point 7), and no company legitimacy is established (Scam point 4). The WHOIS shows the site is extremely new (registered in 2025) with registrant privacy shields up, which is typical of scam pop-up sites. All characteristics indicate this is a Fake Online Shopping scam.
